issues.issue: The General Fund 'Local' line is mostly office charges for services per p2 (Sheriff 331,366, Treasurer 166,232, Emergency Manager 57,983, Clerk 37,483..., 602,495 in total), and the rest are general receipts. Calling all of it fees of office is an assumption. It is also inconsistent with detail[99] (Register of Deeds Local), whose category is 'Fees of Office'.

This is probably inheritance tax collections (Inheritance Tax Fund). The 2026-11-04 fund-name rule only covers a fund's tax lines, not 'Local', so leaving it out of inheritance tax follows the rule. It is a large amount, so the user may want to decide.
